title: Japanese Style Cornish Wrap
description: A fusion dish combining the flavors of Japan and the UK, featuring a Cornish delicacy wrapped in a light Japanese-inspired wrap.

ingredients.name: Cornish Pasty Filling
ingredients.notes: Use leftover pasty filling or make your own

ingredients.name: Charred Sesame Seeds
ingredients.notes: To toast sesame seeds, heat a dry pan over medium heat and stir frequently

ingredients.name: Pickled Ginger
ingredients.notes: Use store-bought or make your own

ingredients.name: Wasabi Mayo
ingredients.notes: Mix mayonnaise and wasabi to taste

ingredients.name: Sliced Cucumber
ingredients.notes: Use thinly sliced cucumber for crunch

ingredients.name: Pickled Carrot
ingredients.notes: Use store-bought or make your own

ingredients.name: Toasted Sesame Oil
ingredients.notes: Use high-quality sesame oil for best flavor

instructions: 1. Lay the Light Seaweed Wrap flat on a clean surface.
2. Spread Wasabi Mayo evenly over the center of the wrap, leaving a 1-inch border on either side.
3. Arrange Cornish Pasty Filling in the center of the wrap, on top of the wasabi mayo.
4. Top the filling with sliced cucumber and pickled carrot.
5. Drizzle Toasted Sesame Oil over the filling.
6. Sprinkle Charred Sesame Seeds over the filling for added crunch.
7. Fold the bottom edge of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap into a tight cylinder.
8. Slice in half and serve immediately.
